reason: We do the zoo, library storytime and church group for free, so $13 a kid is hard to justify on $35k. I might use the free first visit to look, but I wouldn't pay after that.
objection: Paying $13 or more every visit when the zoo and library cost nothing. And will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? The Baby Nook helps, but I'd have to see it.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $5 to $6 a visit, or a free baby-only hour where the older kids aren't there.
